integrity: Mathematical proof with independent finite checks; numerical tests are not proofs for all parameters. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Geodesic hull on H(d,q), integers d,q>=2; asymptotic fixed q, d growing. The binary rank enumeration is classical minimal-set-cover enumeration and is not claimed as new. The claim of novel content is the nonbinary weighted rank spectrum and its direct-versus-multipass representation interpretation. Possible implicit prior colored-cover statements remain a priority risk.
title: Rooted Horn-circuit spectrum of Hamming geodesic convexity and a quasipolynomial direct-basis barrier
